title: BFS 抓取调度：相对链接解析与去重
expected_output:
起始 URL : https://site.example.com/list/1.html

BFS 访问顺序:
  1. https://site.example.com/list/1.html
  2. https://site.example.com/list/2.html
  3. https://site.example.com/detail/a.html
  4. https://site.example.com/detail/b.html
  5. https://site.example.com/detail/1.html

共访问 5 个页面
跳过统计 : {'外部站点': 1, '纯锚点': 1, '已访问': 1}

三个要点:
  1. '../detail/b.html' 基于 /list/2.html 解析 -> /detail/b.html (用当前页作基准)
  2. 'https://other.com/x' 主机不同 -> 跳出本站, 不入队; '../list/2.html' 解析回已访问的 /list/2.html -> 被去重跳过
  3. '1.html' 基于 /detail/a.html 解析 -> /detail/1.html, 是新 URL 所以入队并访问
code:
# BFS 抓取调度: 相对链接解析 + 去重 + 队列
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit, urlunsplit
from collections import deque

START = "https://site.example.com/list/1.html"
GRAPH = {
    "https://site.example.com/list/1.html":  ["2.html", "/detail/a.html", "#top"],
    "https://site.example.com/list/2.html":  ["../detail/b.html", "https://other.com/x"],
    "https://site.example.com/detail/a.html":["../list/2.html", "1.html"],
    "https://site.example.com/detail/b.html":[],
}

def normalize(u):
    s = urlsplit(u)
    return urlunsplit((s.scheme.lower(), s.hostname.lower(), s.path or "/", s.query, ""))

def same_site(u):
    return urlsplit(u).hostname == urlsplit(START).hostname

print("起始 URL :", START)
print("")
q = deque([START])
seen = {normalize(START)}
order = []
skipped = {"外部站点": 0, "纯锚点": 0, "已访问": 0}
while q:
    url = q.popleft()
    order.append(url)
    for href in GRAPH.get(url, []):
        if href.startswith("#"):
            skipped["纯锚点"] += 1
            continue
        nxt = normalize(urljoin(url, href))       # 关键: 基于当前页 URL 解析相对链接
        if not same_site(nxt):
            skipped["外部站点"] += 1
            continue
        if nxt in seen:
            skipped["已访问"] += 1
            continue
        seen.add(nxt)
        q.append(nxt)

print("BFS 访问顺序:")
for i, u in enumerate(order, 1):
    print("  %d. %s" % (i, u))
print("")
print("共访问 %d 个页面" % len(order))
print("跳过统计 :", skipped)
print("")
print("三个要点:")
print("  1. '../detail/b.html' 基于 /list/2.html 解析 -> /detail/b.html (用当前页作基准)")
print("  2. 'https://other.com/x' 主机不同 -> 跳出本站, 不入队; '../list/2.html' 解析回已访问的 /list/2.html -> 被去重跳过")
print("  3. '1.html' 基于 /detail/a.html 解析 -> /detail/1.html, 是新 URL 所以入队并访问")
